blocks.title: Translators
blocks.text: Translators are tools that convert code written in one programming language into a language the computer can understand: they turn high-level languages such as Python into machine language (binary code) that computers can execute.

blocks.caption: Two kinds of translator
rows: translates the entire code at once

blocks.prompt: How does an interpreter differ from a compiler?
blocks.explanation: An interpreter translates and runs the program one line at a time; a compiler translates the whole program into machine code before it is run.

items: Translators convert high-level code into machine language; interpreters line by line (Python), compilers all at once (GCC).
